summary: In src/click/core.py, Option.get_error_hint now appends the env var hint only when show_envvar and envvar are truthy; it treats a str as a one-item list, joins each variable quoted with ', ', and includes a comment noting variable names may contain spaces/commas. Option.get_help_extra now uses the auto-prefix name when envvar is falsy (merged into one condition), and sets extra['envvars'] only when envvar is truthy. Added two CHANGES.md bullets under Unreleased ending with {pr}`3884`. tests/test_options.py passes (676 passed).
concerns: The type hint for the local envvars variable is unannotated, matching surrounding style but worth a glance.
get_help_extra still uses `if envvar:` so a non-empty non-str sequence is handled as before; confirm no behavior change for normal sequences.
